title: Makefaster packages website performance work as a repeating AI loop
friendlyTitle: Makefaster uses AI to test ways to speed up a website
summary: Makefaster is an AI skill that researches a site’s performance, proposes changes, tests them in isolation and applies successful improvements before repeating the cycle. Its public leaderboard reports large average improvements, but those figures are first-party and results will vary by site.
friendlySummary: Makefaster finds website speed problems, tries fixes and measures the result. Its published improvement numbers come from the maker.
whyItMatters: The project turns optimisation into measurable experiments rather than one-shot AI edits. Run it with version control, review each change and watch user-facing metrics so a faster benchmark does not come at the cost of correctness or accessibility.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It could reduce slow page loads without guessing. Keep backups and review every change before putting it on a live site.
